x: Eighteen year-old Frenchman Fabien Bernard-Gaudin, still without first team eligibility, led around the park and into the straight but Joachim Wolf had no intention of leaving things that way and closed him down to squeeze the A team ahead by inches at the takeover.

Steve Zealy was our only legitimate runner, in 62nd spot, but right up the front second-claimer Richard Ashe carried our colours to an outstanding win - although as a guest his name did not feature on the SoT result sheet. Fabien Bernard-Gaudin, still awaiting clearance to score for us, suffered a similar fate.
Fabien Bernard-Gaudin had to pull out of the Junior Men's race; he broke a toe before Christmas and his recovery was not as complete as he had thought.

Rob McHarg ran himself into the 'six' to compete for Belgrave in the Irish Road Relay Championships three weeks later and two who impressed greatly in the 'C' team were the French U20 steeplechaser Fabien Bernard-Gaudin and Norwegian Knut Hegvold.
New member Fabien Bernard-Gaudin, only 18 years old, had a terrific run to gain 13th place but as an unregistered athlete could not score for us.
